description: This file defines the EmailReminder class responsible for sending email reminders for scheduled meetings and calls within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for fetching upcoming activities, preparing email content, and dispatching reminder notifications to involved users, contacts, and leads.

classes.name: EmailReminder
classes.description: A class for managing email reminders for meetings and calls, including retrieving activity data, preparing email content, and sending notifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmailReminder instance, setting the current time and calculating the maximum reminder time window.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that retrieves upcoming activities and sends email reminders accordingly.

methods.name: sendReminders
methods.description: Prepares and sends reminder emails to recipients for a specific activity (meeting or call).

methods.name: setReminderBody
methods.description: Populates email template variables with activity details and user information.

methods.name: getMeetingsForRemind
methods.description: Fetches IDs of upcoming meetings scheduled within the reminder window that haven't yet been reminded.

methods.name: getCallsForRemind
methods.description: Fetches IDs of upcoming calls scheduled within the reminder window that haven't yet been reminded.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Retrieves email addresses of users, contacts, and leads associated with a specific activity for reminder notifications.
